facts: If the defendant or other person refuses to sign the acknowledgment,
court_reasoning: the serving-officer shall affix a copy of the summons on the outer door of the house in which the defendant ordinarily resides
holding: the serving-officer shall affix a copy of the summons on the outer door of the house in which the defendant ordinarily resides and then return the original to the Court from which it issued, with a return endorsed thereon or annexed thereto stating that he has so affixed the copy and the circumstances under which he did so
